fastships_hull_generator - https://github.com/NTNU-IMT/fastships_hull_generator (GPL-3.0, NTNU, John Martin Kleven Godo): demihulls of slender catamarans (hull_generator and mesh_tools).
The package is copied unchanged (the examples with their 30 MB of notebooks and meshes are not). ShipBrain's wrapper is shipbrain/catamaran.py; it needs numba (pip install numba).
